verdict.rationale: Bugbot's evidence describes PR-comment based triggers (e.g. `bugbot run`) and configuration files (BUGBOT.md), but there is no mention of a public API or programmatic endpoint that exposes UI functionality (triggering reviews, retrieving results, configuring effort levels, etc.) outside of comment-based or UI-based workflows. Missing for 10: documented REST/GraphQL API, API authentication, parity statement between API and UI capabilities.
